heading: ITR Deadline: 31 October for Audited Accounts & Penalties
tldr: The Income Tax Return (ITR) filing deadline for Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27) is 31 October 2026 for certain categories of taxpayers.
This deadline primarily applies to companies and individuals, HUFs, firms, or LLPs whose accounts are required to be audited.
Missing this deadline incurs a late filing fee of up to ₹5,000 under Section 234F, along with interest under Section 234A on any unpaid tax.
Beyond monetary penalties, late filing can also lead to the inability to carry forward certain losses to future assessment years.
Even if the original deadline is missed, a belated return can generally be filed by 31 December 2026, though with applicable penalties.
caption:
Heads up! If your business or income needs an audit, mark October 31st on your calendar. That's the last day to file your income tax return without facing fines or losing out on some tax benefits. Don't leave money on the table or get hit with late fees. Learn more about who this deadline applies to and why it matters in our full article.
